column1: # Where each self-check assertion can be answered — the reviewed exception table.
# The *tier* a check lives in already decides its category (see tests/lib/report.sh):
#     L1 syntax     → logic        L2 rehearsal → simulable
#     L3 verdicts   → logic        L0 / L4 / L5 / trailing SKIP → device
# This file only names the ones that differ, so it stays short enough to review, and
# tests/lib/report.sh treats an unknown tier as "unclassified" — which fails CI, so a
# new assertion cannot quietly escape classification.
#   key      an assertion id, or "<tier>:<id>" when the same id appears in two tiers
#   ci       "allow" = a container run is allowed to fail this (it needs the phone)
#            "-"     = failing it in CI is a real regression
# Keep this list honest: "allow" means "this machine cannot answer that question",
# never "this check is allowed to be broken".
